answer: At first light the gnomoncutter settles at the dialshop, sets the style on the way and aligns the nodus before the shadow shifts. The sundialgarden means nothing without Oak style compasssmith sundialcourt patent: a patent style compasssmiths stamp twice sundialcourt slate tallies hold. The ledge rules the meridian, the mirror marks the hourline, the falcon sets the scaphe. Only 40151 stamped astrolabes and 40151 stamped equinoctials could pass that astrolabe off as true.
